## The problem

<!-- What breaks today, or what is missing. Start here, not with the solution.
     "A contributor bounced off CI three times because the pre-flight did not
     check the test command" is a problem. "Add a --fast flag" is a solution. -->

## Why the existing skills do not cover it

<!--
This is the section that decides whether the issue gets worked. Be specific
about the boundary:

  - a genuinely new capability no existing skill owns, or
  - an existing skill that hits a wall, and where.

If it is "a new skill", say which of the current ones would wrongly trigger
instead. If it is "an existing skill", name the section that is too narrow.
-->

## Proposed shape

<!-- Optional. Rough is fine. A one-line description of what the skill would do
     and when it would trigger is enough to discuss. -->

## Cost

<!-- Roughly how many tokens per invocation, and how often it would run.
     Every skill in this project states its own budget; yours should start
     with one. -->

## Alternatives considered

<!-- Including "do nothing". A feature that is not worth its maintenance should
     not be built, and saying so is a contribution. -->
